senses.gloss: m. (Shaf. of רפרף, v. רָפַף) a sort of camp stool.
units: Ḥag. 14ᵃ (ref. to Dan. VII, 9) כסא … ש׳ להדום רגליו a throne to sit on, and a sh’rafraf for his footstool.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite> <he>מתגלגלים … אדני ש׳</he> the wheels of his throne roll, and the rests of the footstool tremble.—V. <cite ref="U02044"><he>שַׁרְשִׁיפָא</he></cite>.
